mapper.sql: id, order_number, merchant_id, type, gross, commission_rate, commission, net, bill_id, gmt_created
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_ledger (id, order_number, merchant_id, type, gross, commission_rate, commission, net, bill_id, gmt_created) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderNumber}, #{merchantId}, #{type}, #{gross}, #{commissionRate}, #{commission}, #{net}, #{billId}, #{gmtCreated})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM settlement_ledger WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND type = 'EARN' AND bill_id IS NULL ORDER BY gmt_created
SELECT FROM settlement_ledger WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY gmt_created DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net), 0) FROM settlement_ledger WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(commission), 0) FROM settlement_ledger WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId}
